name: Lirdynrae
source: Spiders are meant to be monsters, creating webs to trap their prey before sinking in their fangs! Lirdynrae would seem to be the exception to this rule. Demure and softly spoken, but protective to a fault when it comes to her fairy friend. She likes to be useful with her silk, and hates the idea that she might scare people.
